evidence: Stack cache recursively builds Python tuples along every prefix; unusually deep stacks can hit recursion limit, and missing/empty samples or zero measured CPU fail via trace[-1], division or max. Acceptance: iterative stack traversal and explicit no-valid-samples report.

CPU samples are included by endpoint timestamp rather than requiring full CPU-delta interval inside measured phase; boundary samples can include warmup CPU. Acceptance: clip intervals or require previous/current timestamps inside phase and report excluded duration.
Workload scales and 500 Hz/10 Hz labels hardcoded rather than derived from capture metadata.

Incomplete curated engine pairs are silently skipped even while header counts all configurations and upstream missing statuses are explicitly visible. Duplicate (config,case,engine) rows overwrite silently. Acceptance: validate unique complete pairs or render missing/duplicate statuses and exclude them transparently from totals.
Uses imported CONFIGS and fixed host/runtime/heap/warmup narratives instead of provenance/worker metadata; renderer can mislabel captures after runtime/config changes.
Missing perf event values use total(event) default zero; absent cache-misses and genuine zero are conflated. Acceptance: preserve unavailable counter status and multiplex/scaling validity.
Host model, cores, heap, toolchain, warmup duration narratives hardcoded; script accepts arbitrary compatible result directories without validating these claims.
Assumes nonempty metrics/events and hardcodes 10 Hz label; missing capture data crashes without explicit incomplete status.

Uses fixed CONFIGS and source-partition label; does not verify worker parameters agree. Instructions/query estimated with median latency times mean rate, unlike measured-throughput estimate elsewhere; label remains estimated but cross-report comparisons need same definition.
Hardcodes 20 samples, 100k/50k rows, local14 and heap48GiB in generated report regardless of worker metadata. Acceptance: derive configuration/provenance or enforce expected capture fingerprint.

Resume verifies claimed commit, seconds and configs but retains old captures after script hashes change; records script_hashes_on_resume without invalidating prior results. --commit is caller-supplied and not checked against actual installed native wheel/source. Acceptance: each capture retains immutable source/binary/runner hashes and mixed-provenance resumes reject or explicitly separate series.
Capture/provenance subprocesses have no timeout; a hung collector blocks the suite indefinitely. Acceptance: bounded process-tree lifecycle and explicit failed capture record.

Allows existing output directory and overwrites provenance with fresh runs list; partial prior artifacts can become mixed with new run. Acceptance: fresh-run directory or configuration/hash-validated resume, atomic report replacement.
Compilers checked before captures and reported afterward, but runtime contention is not rejected during capture. Process-name heuristic is only a partial idle-host guarantee.

Resume retains previous case results while replacing runner/upstream hash fields with current hashes, checking only engine/smoke/data directory. Native fixture cache completeness is marker-only, without fixture builder/source/binary identity. Acceptance: pin capture and fixture fingerprints and reject/migrate stale cache explicitly.

Worker cleanup kills process group only while primary worker is alive (normal completed path simply joins); primary can exit while JVM/helpers remain. SIGTERM cleanup escalates only if primary remains alive, so surviving descendants can contaminate later cases. Acceptance: verify/reap owned process group after primary termination too.

AST adapter removes pytest decorators and manually reconstructs fixture/parameter behavior; upstream source changes can silently diverge (for example parametrization argnames list unsupported by inventory branch using split). Acceptance: fail closed on unsupported decorators/signatures and cross-check collected case IDs/arguments with pytest collection.
Published fixture downloads lack expected content checksum/version, so exact dimensions alone do not establish stable exact fixture content. Acceptance: record/verify input digests.

Failed cases are recorded but script exits successfully; calling harness cannot equate subprocess zero status with all cases passed. Acceptance: aggregate exit status reflects failures while preserving report.

Several named workloads only assert force-count output, not projected field/scan/lookup values. Whether operators are actually forced depends on _force_count implementation/optimizer; ensure value-consuming checksum or verified physical plan for performance claims. This is benchmark validation gap, not a demonstrated production defect.
Input validation omits positive iterations/scale/cores and legal VCF position range; zero iterations produces caught failure instead of early configuration error.
Claims single ordered physical stream and preserved Hail logical partitions, and future optimizer integration, despite current logical planner and deliberate partition divergence.
Persistence section promises logical/empty partition boundaries and file rollover at partition boundaries; actual keyed writer coalesces sorted input streams and rolls by byte/row budgets.
Claims primitive ASCII-only certified keys and several private read options unavailable; current native type/key and interval paths exceed those stated limits.

_mismatches and _transition index captured full allele strings inside per-character array callbacks. This copies/scans repeated strings and can be quadratic in allele length; prefer native linear character comparison (hamming already exists) and a one-pass transition kernel.

_physical(tndarray) calls arr.ravel().tolist() and reconstructs Python scalar lists before creating Arrow buffers. _logical(tndarray) similarly boxes to a Python list before NumPy allocation. Shared Arrow/NumPy buffer interoperability should avoid these full scalar round trips.

Locus conversion repeatedly calls dtype.reference_genome and contigs.index; the type accessor rebuilds the complete reference mapping, so N locus literals can perform O(N * number_of_contigs) metadata work.

SwitchBuilder._finish repeats the base expression in each case rather than binding it once. Cost depends on optimizer reuse; this is a confirmed repeated-IR construction, not a demonstrated post-optimization quadratic benchmark.

_direct_literal_array/_dict_from_entries choose last-key-wins for syntactically literal arrays and first-key-wins for computed arrays. Reproduced identical values yielding {1:3} versus {1:2}. This deliberately reproduces an upstream constant-folding artifact; a coherent duplicate-key policy needs an explicit compatibility decision.

BlockMatrix is only a constant-fill entry-table interoperability wrapper. fill accepts block_size without using or rejecting it; actual block storage/algebra is absent. Clarify/reject unsupported sizing rather than imply it controls execution.
nd.array delegates through arrow_literal, whose ndarray conversion boxes NumPy buffers into Python scalar lists; see arrow.py.

_query_rows eagerly evals any non-row-indexed query key, including global-dependent expressions, while constructing the query expression. This creates an action boundary and materializes keys before normal action planning; dynamic native bounds should be bound at the owning action instead.

ReferenceGenome.__eq__ builds full mapping/list definitions for comparison; Locus validation reads the copying lengths property repeatedly and contig ordinals use tuple.index. Together with tlocus.reference_genome reconstruction this causes metadata work proportional to reference size per scalar locus. Prefer shared native immutable reference handles and cached ordinal lookup.

_slice_bound(step) and _translate_dynamic build a position array and call substring/index on a captured whole string per element. This repeats full string capture/copy and Unicode traversal rather than scanning once. Dynamic translation also captures the complete dictionary per character. A typed native scalar kernel should consume string/codepoints and dictionary once.

translate evaluates a native literal dictionary through hl.eval during expression construction to recover a Python mapping. This is pure literal data, but introduces an unnecessary action/latency boundary.
_min_rep scans allele strings via captured per-character substring/index callbacks, repeating the same string-capture cost as strings.py/allele_functions.py.

split_multi_hts builds and rescans the original O(A^2) genotype PL coordinates for each of A split alleles, yielding O(A^3) work relative to O(A^2) input. Native shared downcoding can compute incident minima and the few excluded-allele minima once per original variant.

title: Native semantic identity and effects replace fresh IDs / blanket volatile kernels
evidence: logical_expr semantic kernel keys retain native expression DAG + exact Arrow schema
restore_type immutable scalar preserves List/Struct field metadata through folding
scan state/scope adapters use native semantic keys
configured reducer wrapper forwards full behavioral contract
pure custom string kernels have stable native identity
Native DAG hash/equality memoization; depth64 public HashSet/planner tests under external resource guard
limits: MayError deliberately maps to Volatile because DataFusion exposes no independent error-order movement effect.
Unknown function names conservatively remain MayError; no effects are accepted from Python.
Per-expression typing/physical compilation now memoized. Logical planning and repeated runtime expression evaluation still need separate end-to-end measurement.

title: Shared native DAG typing and physical compilation use per-request context memoization
evidence: CompilationMemo keys by live native node address plus exact schema/global/lexical context. Generated execution rewrites retained in a local Arc arena. Deterministic 64-level graph asserts 65 typing and physical-construction cache misses. Runtime Rust suite exposed an additional exponential DataFusion metadata recursion despite 65 native cache misses. CompiledPhysical now binds exact return Field once per native node/context and shares the context schema; root data_type/nullability and bounded diagnostic checks added to the unchanged depth-64 regression. Physical hashes cached after child facades are bound. Exact dynamic DF equality uses a synchronous comparison-scoped thread-local pair/result map, RAII-cleared on return/unwind; retains no node ownership and no cross-comparison cache. Depth64 regression also compares independently rebuilt physical graphs. Reviewer requested black-box validation: removed private visit/work counters, retained depth64 using public type/physical/logical APIs with metadata and rebuilt equality, plus actual small-graph value execution.
next_step: Execute unchanged depth64 graph compilation/metadata/rebuild-equality regression, then full execution tests. Shared runtime edge evaluation remains K007; no end-to-end performance completion claim.

title: Generic Arrow table import combines valid input batches before reslicing them
evidence: parallelize_arrow collects the stream and concat_batches merges every chunk solely because the table input node requires one RecordBatch. A multi-chunk Arrow table already has native columnar buffers; concatenation allocates combined buffers for multiple nonempty batches.
next_step: Let the native table input descriptor retain Vec<RecordBatch>/schema and partition or stream original batches without whole-table concatenation. Verify buffer addresses, row order and peak allocation across multiple chunks.
limits: Single-row scalar import has a legitimate cardinality/materialization contract; this finding does not classify every concat_batches call as a defect. No throughput number claimed.

title: Fold reducers still use closure identity and scalar conversion that can erase nested metadata
evidence: FoldProgram carries native sequence/combine source and compilation bindings; fold identity includes initial value and actual schema. Metadata-preserving scalar_at used for update/merge states.
next_step: Execute nested-set fold regression and canonical fold identity tests.

title: Integer unary negation had scalar/array overflow disagreement
evidence: DataFusion NegativeExpr uses checked ScalarValue arithmetic_negate for scalar MIN but neg_wrapping for arrays. Both Vail lowering paths now use integer wrapping subtraction (0 - value), retaining ordinary floating negation.

title: Native field inspection constructs every field of a node
evidence: Except op, get/getitem creates a full PyDict shallow view and all child wrappers. A literal dtype inquiry also converts its value to a one-row Arrow array and creates NativeArrow/RecordBatch even when that value was not requested.
next_step: Profile planning/IR traversal calls; provide direct native field access or native traversal/rewriting for hot analysis paths. Preserve explicit view() as diagnostic compatibility inspection.

title: Deep debug/repr formatting expands shared DAGs despite bounded semantic identity
evidence: NativeExpr repr summarizes operation; semantic Identity Debug summarizes fingerprint/node count; keyed UDF Debug summarizes name. Raw internal Expr Debug remains recursive and is not intended for bounded handle diagnostics.

title: Shared logical subgraphs use bounded native kernels; shared runtime evaluation remains queued
evidence: lower_logical detects multiply referenced native non-leaf nodes in a unique traversal and retains those subgraphs as native semantic kernels. Ordinary surrounding operators remain visible to optimization. This bounds boxed logical trees, while DF physical evaluation still follows repeated edges.
next_step: Run external bounded-resource depth64 public compilation test and representative real queries. Runtime shared-expression scheduling needs per-batch intermediates with lexical/effect correctness; do not evaluate huge doubling graphs.

title: Projection fields create independent compilation memo contexts
evidence: validate_projection_with_globals invokes root dtype per output; CompiledProjection compiles each field independently, repeating shared source subgraphs across fields.
next_step: Retain one request memo for an entire projection with unchanged global bindings.

title: Length-validator reducer still uses captured factory identity
evidence: Factory uses create_udaf; equivalent validators receive fresh captured factory closure identities.
next_step: Use native keyed aggregate helper with exact validator configuration and preserve reducer contract.

title: Nested collection scalar adapters bypass metadata-preserving conversion
evidence: Collection grouping, matrix gather/transpose scalar adapters now use shared scalar_at. Transpose and dense scatter clone source Fields rather than reconstructing metadata-free Fields.
next_step: Run Set/Dict-valued scalar grouping regression; route nested output through metadata-preserving native helper. collection_lookup directly retains its StructArray and is not affected.

title: Hypergeometric samplers perform one random draw per sampled item
evidence: hyper loops 0..sample and multi_hyper repeats that draw loop for colors with remaining sample count; large population/sample requests therefore take linear sampling work rather than parameter-bounded rejection/inversion work.
next_step: Use validated hypergeometric distribution algorithm with explicit stream-compatibility policy and small/exhaustive distribution tests; benchmark large balanced populations.

title: Downsample rebins retained grid on each expanding bound
evidence: Any new min/max takes the retained BTreeMap and reinserts all representatives; monotone expanding points can repeatedly rebin O(divisions^2) retained state.
next_step: Compare upstream algorithm and use amortized bounds expansion or an equivalent streaming spatial sketch; preserve retained-point and merge semantics.

title: Linear regression solves normal equations with explicit matrix inverse
evidence: Accumulator retains XTX and XTy, then try_inverse and multiplication; conditioning is squared relative to X and subtractive RSS may lose precision. Existing ordinary examples cannot establish ill-conditioned behavior.
next_step: Audit Hail numerical contract, add rank-deficient/ill-conditioned cases and assess mergeable QR or stable symmetric solve with rank detection. No unsupported claim of observed incorrect output.

title: KLL accumulator state uses serialized sketch bytes
evidence: DataFusion accumulator state is Arrow Binary; kll-rs exposes serialize/deserialize for mergeable sketch state. This is internal Rust aggregate state transfer, not Python/Rust IR serialization.
next_step: DF state must be Arrow-representable for partial/final aggregation, spill and shuffle. kll-rs exposes serialize/deserialize and merge without native retained-level export/import. Keep Binary codec at this boundary; do not use opaque pointers that invalidate externalization. Avoid unnecessary state() calls.

title: Random ndarray dimensions pass through f64
evidence: norm_nd/unif_nd read int64 rows/columns through number() -> f64 -> i64. Exact dimensions beyond 2^53 can change; even zero-by-large shapes need exact original int64 dimensions despite having no data allocation.
next_step: Read typed Int64Array dimensions directly and test a zero-length ndarray with a large second dimension.

evidence: Deleted DeferredOrderedExec and deferred_logical.rs; physical semantic helper requires Prepared children and cannot recurse on TableIR; joins/lookup/zip use visible planned children; stream relational rewrites happen before logical planning. Removed both runtime initializer execution nodes and all execute-time compile callbacks. ActionParameters resolves explicit singleton parameter relations, caches native Arrow rows once per logical initializer per action, then compiles the resolved data tree once using one SessionState/RuntimeEnv/TaskContext. Native stable sorts and head are normal logical operators; tail retains bounded suffix memory as a semantic extension.
acceptance: Fullcompile; instrumented provider proves lazy EXPLAIN/resolution do not construct data plans and final physical data source constructed once; aggregate/scan globals/fold/nested/empty/replay correctness; optimizer pushdown and randomness tests.
limitations: General joins/lookups/complex sorts remain explicit semantic extensions (children visible, scalar semantics opaque); partition remapping/count/sampling preparation remains separate costs under A003/A007. Intentional partition divergence is not claimed implemented by this patch. Scalar-binding and data-dependent semantic physical diagnostics now return explicit nonexecuting UnboundActionExec nodes with visible dependencies instead of executing initialization/bounds/count relations. Full runtime integration validation remains pending.

evidence: join_interval::bounds calls scan_bounds if no inherited certified bounds; scan_bounds executes every row in each partition before final join executes. partitioned::shuffle uses partition_counts and key_ranges, then replays physical child plans. This is physical execution during plan preparation rather than invisible TableIR compilation, but can add full data passes and latency.
acceptance: Certified source bounds prune without reads; otherwise use engine joins/repartition strategy avoiding a mandatory full prepass. Instrument actual source batches/read counts, not Arc identities; ensure bounded output buffers and cancellation.

evidence: lookup::prepare constructs right_reduced once but installs Arc clones under one join per left partition; Arc sharing does not memoize build-side execution. Interval join cells likewise can reopen overlapping source readers across cells.
acceptance: Count executions and bytes read of shared right side for many left partitions; use shared action-local build/exchange or native optimizer join strategy; do not collect whole table into Python.

evidence: lower_rng_uids restores partitions using child.known_n_partitions().unwrap_or(1); unknown metadata is treated as physical singleton. Existing logical scan restoration similarly uses metadata count. This should be redesigned around semantic row/RNG identity and engine partition properties, not unsupported Hail partition identities.
acceptance: Randomness/scan results must remain correct and repeatable over unknown-cardinality filters, unions, sorts, joins and empty inputs with real parallel physical execution.

evidence: Rust TableIR::explain and GlobalsIR::explain still put Expr into serde_json::json!, while Expr::RuntimeLiteral is #[serde(skip)] and serialization is unsupported. Python Native IR view avoids this; direct Rust diagnostics with native literals can panic.
acceptance: Native structured/explain formatting covers native literals without serializing execution data or panicking; diagnostic path tested with arrays, nonfinite values and empty structs.

evidence: Replaced hidden RngContextExec and unbounded active runs with visible ConsumerScopeExec. Explicit consumer/action forks allocate fresh identity; optimizer copies reunify only with shared private lineage, matching ordered physical leaf identities, schema, distribution and ordering. Runtime execute claims each consumer partition once and delegates the exposed producer; no compiler, reset/replay construction, or request-driven choice. Unit regressions compile under check8; runtime and integration pending.
acceptance: Expose actual data dependency, identify action/consumer/replay explicitly, release state at completion/cancellation, preserve interleaved/repeated determinism and shared exchange execution. Count graph/run lifetimes and retained memory; do not replace the heuristic with another partition-order assumption.

evidence: join_partition chooses NestedLoopJoinExec with IntervalContains filter in both interval_mode and query_interval_mode over each complete left partition and the whole right relation; candidate comparisons are O(L*R), independent of small match output.
acceptance: Native output-sensitive interval containment join/index/sweep with deterministic first-match and all-matches ordering, missing/open endpoints, overlap, composite/locus keys; count candidate comparisons at increasing input sizes.

evidence: lookup::collect_right equality all_matches and partition_grouping::lower_group_within still call stock array_agg_udaf. Other paths in this codebase explicitly replace it because stock ScalarValue compaction drops tagged metadata and panics on nested zero-field structs. Grouping also uses first_value per key, another known scalar compaction path. logical_nested_aggregation::collect intentionally chooses stock ordered array_agg because plain collect cannot merge independently ordered partial states; the fix must preserve ordering/merge state, not blindly substitute the unordered UDAF.
acceptance: Use the common Arrow-native collect/take reducer contract, prove nested empty structs, tagged call/locus/set/tuple/ndarray payloads preserve types; ensure contiguous grouping emits with bounded state rather than retaining all groups.

evidence: Native filter/interval scalar endpoints are encoded as one-element Arrow IPC KeyValue::ArrowIpc for in-memory QueryInterval. interval_read::endpoint immediately decodes the just-created bytes, and compare_key decodes both sides and constructs comparators inside sort comparisons. Persisted index transport is being reused as live native endpoint representation.
acceptance: Decode persisted bounds once into typed native Arrow endpoints; compare/sort/index native typed arrays directly. Keep byte encoding only at external storage boundaries and preserve prefix/open/null comparator semantics. Measure codec/comparator constructions for many intervals.

evidence: intervals_for_filter returns None unless exactly one table/index key field and a direct column-vs-literal Eq/Lt/Le/Gt/Ge Boolean expression. Composite key-prefix equality/ranges, IN, and other provably indexable predicate shapes fall back to full reads. Explicit interval_read supports richer prefix pruning, but ordinary filters do not share that algebra.
acceptance: Share typed predicate-bound extraction with interval pruning; prove impossible files/segments are not opened with counters or deleted-file tests, including composite prefixes, conjunctions with unsupported residuals, nulls, casts and overlapping unions. Preserve residual predicate correctness.

evidence: DifferentExpr exact key pairs use Arrow total-order comparator rather than shared logical key equality. Installed-native reproduction: Table.parallelize([{k:0.0}],key=k)._same(Table.parallelize([{k:-0.0}],key=k)) returned False, while joins explicitly equate signed zero and values_similar uses numeric equality.
acceptance: Use one native semantic key equality across joins/group/comparison. Check signed zeros, NaNs, nested numeric keys, missing values and reordered duplicate groups; preserve approximate payload tolerance.
resolution: Exact key pairs use existing recursive native values_similar at zero absolute tolerance, which preserves signed-zero and NaN logical equality recursively instead of Arrow sort order. Added scalar/nested key cases and relaxed payload tolerance must not relax keys.

evidence: extract groups each distinct agg.filter step vector into a separate scope. lower total/grouped/body clones the complete row input into each scope and joins independently aggregated outputs. Distinct nonkey conditional reducers can execute/read the same source once per scope rather than one row pass with per-aggregate FILTER.
acceptance: Instrument actual source executions/batches/bytes for many conditional reducers; fuse compatible filter-only leaves in a shared Aggregate with individual filters. Preserve exploded/nested scope domains, missing/empty defaults, RNG and validation order; use explicit exchanges when true multi-scope fanout is necessary.

evidence: coordinate_reductions uses Aggregate.result_type.unwrap_or(Int64) as cast target for coordinate sum, even though result_type is optional/defaulted in native Expr. A directly constructed native float sum with None annotation is rewritten to integer cast; Python usually supplies annotation so compatibility tests do not cover the native default case. Installed-native reproduction: range_table(2).annotate(xs=[0.25,0.75]) aggregate array_agg(sum) returns [0.5,1.5]. Rebuilding only the inner native Aggregate without optional __vail_result_type metadata produces external globals type mismatch when used with the same inferred frontend array<float64> type, proving semantic type changes based on the annotation.
acceptance: Infer coordinate mapped argument/reducer output type in Rust from lexical element type. The annotation may validate inferred type, never choose different numerical semantics. Cover native IR without annotations for Int32/Int64/Float32/Float64 and nested lambda expressions.
resolution: Coordinate sum no longer pre-casts from optional frontend annotation. Shared native sum UDAF infers widened output from mapped Arrow element type. Regression reconstructs native float Aggregate with omitted hint and checks numerical result.

evidence: GlobalsIR::aggregate and TableIR::grouped_aggregate_bound infer output schema by lowering the complete existing relational input plus aggregate logical plan at construction, which is rebuilt again for actions. Nested scan fold constructs dummy empty physical MemorySource solely to feed schema into lower_fold. These duplicate planner/probe work instead of using a direct native scoped typing contract.
acceptance: Instrument logical node constructions and frontend latency for deep chains/branching nested aggregate construction. Use direct native scoped type/reducer return contracts, retaining eager type validation without building executable placeholder relations.

evidence: write_with_options first prepares rows, then independently executes globals.evaluate before writer pulls the rows; globals used inside row plans are separate physical producers. same() independently compiles left and right global actions and then row comparison. The new action binding context fixes initializer+data ownership but these outer multi-root actions remain separate resource/execution scopes.
acceptance: Represent all roots of a write/comparison under one action context and share required singleton producers once per action; preserve pinned snapshot/RNG identity, bounded writer backpressure and cancellation. Count global-aggregate source executions as well as RuntimeEnv ownership.

evidence: Root traced _generate contexts.flatmap(rowfn) through parallelize_expression to ExpressionSourceExec OnceCell: evaluate singleton full output array, collect, then slice generated rows. _generate/BaldingNichols throughput and peak memory therefore scale with total output before yielding.
acceptance: Lower generator context partitions into a native streaming source evaluating rowfn per context/partition with bounded batches, avoiding one total-output Arrow array. Test peak memory, first-batch latency and actual concurrent context work; generic parallelize(existing array) may still materialize its already-localized array.

evidence: Full pytest reset event logs; body attempts no longer silently reuse numeric result paths. Scope subprocess test reruns same output with changed failing body.
Body NameError/KeyError classified as behavior failures, not automatically fixture failures; tested backend classification.

Removed hardcoded 51-module/three-crash/120-second claims from report generator. Further work: report merges multiple body directories and identifies current native hash at reporting time rather than executed-native hash; must retain per-attempt provenance and refuse incompatible mixes.

Several historical original-body runners independently implement decorator stripping, fixture injection and result aggregation; some omit class lifecycle/marks. Isolated bodies must remain labelled and must never count as equivalent pytest coverage. Consolidate current runner selection/attempt schema; preserve historical evidence.

hl.dtype('struct{`é`: int32}') returns field name Ã©. Parser encodes already-decoded Unicode as UTF-8 bytes and applies unicode_escape to all bytes. Local Hail utils.java::unescape_parsable has the same implementation: inherited Unicode behavior, not evidence that Vail uniquely introduced the shortcut. Vail codepoint contract should preserve literal Unicode.
acceptance: Parse escape sequences without corrupting literal Unicode; preserve non-ASCII codepoints and escaped backticks/backslashes, reject malformed escapes.

evidence: Importing types.py replaces pprint.PrettyPrinter process-wide with a subclass of its current value. This modifies unrelated callers and repeated module reload can chain incompatible printer subclasses.
acceptance: Use a scoped pretty-print integration or explicitly justified registration preserving other caller behavior; test import/reload and unrelated nested objects.

evidence: Array.index maps integer indices and captures full input array; array arithmetic maps indices and captures both input arrays. Native lambda captured arrays are repeated per lane, causing avoidable quadratic copying.
acceptance: Native zip/enumeration of child values; preserve lengths/missingness/errors and callback RNG semantics, show linear input processing.

evidence: ir_view::table recursively materializes every child into dictionaries, with no memo or node references; a union repeatedly duplicating the same child can expand a shared relational DAG exponentially.
acceptance: Bounded summary or DAG-aware diagnostic graph with explicit node references; no implicit execution or serialization required for inspection.

evidence: _key_filter_intervals calls eval on scalar/global-dependent bound expressions while constructing Table.filter, before an action. filter_intervals also localizes expression-valued interval collections at construction.
acceptance: Carry typed bound expressions into native logical/action parameter phase; no data-source reads during transformation construction; prove counters remain zero until action.

evidence: Python independently recognizes key comparisons and reconstructs locus/contig intervals, duplicating provider/interval_read native algebra. Matrix filter_intervals validates through a discarded row-table result and then builds a per-row OR of interval predicates rather than carrying the interval-read node.
acceptance: One native typed bound algebra and logical interval filter preserving file pruning through table/matrix transformations. Prove impossible segments not opened, not partition counts.

evidence: _referenced_columns, _validate_aggregate_ir, _ir_has_aggregate and bind.check_scope recursively visit every edge without native-node memoization; NativeExpr wrappers are recreated for children. Shared x=x+x graphs can expand paths exponentially despite fixed native identity hashing.
acceptance: Native DAG-aware analysis with lexical/aggregate context in visited keys; deterministic unique-node work-count regressions.

evidence: Table._generate constructs contexts.flatmap(rowfn) into one array expression and only then requests n partitions through parallelize_expression. Need verify source execution does not first materialize all generated rows in one singleton array. Confirmed ExpressionSourceExec collects one singleton array and caches all output rows before slicing it across source partitions.
acceptance: Inspect/measure peak memory and first-batch latency for large generated data; native context-partition streaming producer if singleton materialization confirmed.

evidence: _axis_aggregates constructs a separate entry context/grouped aggregate/lookup for each aggregate subtree/field. Identical context Arc sharing alone does not guarantee common execution.
acceptance: Fuse compatible column aggregates under one native grouped aggregate and one join; count source reads for increasing output fields.

evidence: choose_cols calls count_cols, union_rows counts and collects both column key lists during transformation construction. Native column-global dependencies may include prior row aggregations.
acceptance: Native lazy validation in the action graph, with explicit metadata actions only where schema fundamentally depends on values (make_table).

evidence: show obtains headers from matrix.cols().collect() (key sorted) but cell values from localized row slots (physical column order). choose_cols with reordered keys can label values with the wrong sample, same pattern as fixed VCF export bug. Reproduced headers0.x/1.x with values11/10 after choose_cols([1,0]); now headers follow owning slot order, regression passed.
acceptance: Read bounded headers from owning column_records in slot order; test reversed/duplicate selections and nontrivial keys.

evidence: Column explode constructs range(length(values)).map(lambda j:struct(index=j,value=values[j])), capturing complete array per lane; same quadratic lambda-copy pattern fixed for zip/index.
acceptance: Native indexed zip/enumerate of values with linear work and stable occurrence identities.

evidence: to_matrix_table resolves last duplicate coordinate through agg.collect(entry)[-1], retaining every duplicate payload when only one result is needed.
acceptance: Shared ordered last-value accumulator with bounded state and deterministic source order; count retained bytes for many duplicates.

evidence: filter_entries projects only _ROW/_CELLS, unlike annotate_entries which preserves hidden row_index_keys. Core index/order metadata is discarded before later row predicates, potentially losing pruning.
acceptance: Preserve certified row-key columns/order through entry-only transformations; verify impossible files remain unopened after filter_entries followed by key filter.

evidence: run_all_tests.classify python_tests returns passed for code0 without any recognized pytest outcome count, unlike Rust/native/oracle branches which require evidence. Summary parsing depends on the last stdout line.
acceptance: Use structured pytest outcomes or require valid explicit summary; absent/malformed successful evidence cannot become a passing suite. Test empty stdout and trailing plugin diagnostics.

evidence: profile_annotate/profile_samples/profile_cloud wait indefinitely for ready/go/worker report while a native worker remains alive. profile_samples does not terminate worker in a finally block on monitor errors; counters can fail while query continues.
acceptance: Explicit run deadline and owned process-group cleanup on monitor failure/cancellation; distinguish timed-out work from reported throughput.

evidence: Historical inventory renderers embed fixed primitive/unsupported storage and array claims, independent of runtime evidence. Dedicated remaining count subtracts body_results over all rows rather than restricting the same dedicated scope. Preserve pinned source count guards, but derive support claims and denominators from matching evidence.
acceptance: Separate historical source requirements from current implementation evidence; counters filtered to identical scope, no hardcoded current support claims.

evidence: Removed per-allele repeated scans and separately implemented mean/stddev/boolean reducers. Native list adapters invoke the same configured UDAFs as tables. Per-row initializer applies before even an empty list. One borrowed Arrow list slice and one accumulator update per row. Native adapter owns argument arity/type validation; generic collection validation delegates to that contract. Ordered/unordered take now share native table reducer too.
acceptance: Parity across table/list/matrix including large ints, missing calls, haploid/phased calls, empty inputs and row-varying allele count. Complexity O(called alleles + output allele count), independent of allele-count times call-count.

evidence: HailAccumulator::update_batch uses ScalarValue::try_from_array inside the input-element loop for float sum, mean, product and Boolean any/all/fraction; only integer sum, min/max and count_where have native batch paths.
acceptance: Typed Arrow batch kernels or typed loops with no per-element ScalarValue allocation; preserve ordering/numeric overflow, null and nonfinite semantics. Quantify input values processed vs boxed conversions.

evidence: TakeAccumulator::append computes lexsort_to_indices twice in the ordered branch; its first value-only result is discarded when retaining ordered value/key state.
acceptance: One top-k selection per update and retain original value/key pairs; no redundant sorting. Unordered take need not copy whole incoming arrays once n retained.
resolution: One ordered top-k selection retains full value/key state. Unordered take slices incoming values to remaining capacity, compacts the retained output, and ignores later input once full. Lists/matrices now invoke this same native take reducer (including ordered take) with native Int64 n.

evidence: Collection aggregation explicitly rejects nested agg.explode; matrix list aggregation explicitly rejects agg.fold. These are explicit unsupported cases rather than silently inaccurate answers. Ordered take gap was resolved using shared native kernel.
acceptance: Native layout adapters reuse existing aggregate scope/fold semantics, not separate per-domain kernels. Add nested collection/matrix scope coverage.

evidence: Expression-valued one_sided builds if_else over two separate hardy_weinberg_test aggregate expressions. Both aggregate states may count the same calls when mode cannot be selected before planning.
acceptance: Assess actual optimized execution; if both states execute, share genotype count state and apply mode at finalization, with lazy/global/aggregate mode semantics retained.

evidence: Direct entry sum retains its existing Arrow list-sum kernel, mapping absent cells to missing and casting to declared widened result first. This is an efficient layout specialization but remains distinct from HailAccumulator API.
acceptance: Explicit parity for widened int64, float64, empty/all-missing, sparse cells, overflow and nonfinite input; move shared semantics down if any mismatch.

evidence: Collection visitor wraps a mapped IR subtree using declared aggregate result type as a transient frontend placeholder, while native dtype_scoped infers actual mapped input type. Matrix visitor typed() creates a schema-only table projection probe to recover native inferred type. No runtime wrong cast is performed, but frontend type placeholders/probes complicate native-handle architecture.
acceptance: Expose direct scoped native expression type inference with lambda bindings, remove temporary incorrect frontend type wrappers and table projection probes. Check captured globals and lambda context without any execution.

evidence: Runtime Endpoint/QueryInterval keys retain ArrowIpc(Vec<u8>) transport payloads rather than typed Arrow owners. select/select_many decode them again; comparisons themselves are native Arrow. Persistence needs a codec, in-memory bounds do not.

Each persisted scalar endpoint is a complete Arrow IPC stream serialized as a JSON byte array, repeating per-scalar schema/type metadata. Deserialize additionally clones serialized fragments and sorts them again before verifying stored order. Index size/loading can be dominated by repeated metadata instead of key values.

select_many performs a complete fragment sweep for every query list except exactly one interval. Sparse two-interval queries over a large index therefore require O(F) metadata work; merged interval windows could use binary searches and ordered union for output-sensitive selection.

Index certification allows equality at adjacent file endpoints, including arbitrarily many duplicate-point files. This is correct for current inclusive pruning but is not a strict public-key-range-disjoint file guarantee; duplicate-run policy needs an explicit decision.

stream_from_plan_with_nested_projection selects candidate files but passes the existing unfiltered FileScanTask predicate through unchanged. Requested key intervals are residual slices after decoding, so this path does not push them down into Vortex segment reads.
write_initial_file_stream allows 32 simultaneous complete file buffers independent of query memory reservations. Upstream producer buffers/channels add retained memory outside that count.

VailSemantics uses untyped JSON metadata and writer validation only rejects null/missing values; structural equivalence of row/global logical types and actual Arrow/Iceberg schemas remains deferred (also admitted in README).

load_snapshot_read_plan accepts a keyed single-file snapshot without an index. This is not by itself proof of an ordering bug, but callers must not advertise sortedness solely from semantic key names.
Fixed 32 producer permits, per-producer 64MiB staging buffers, full-buffer channels and up to 32 physical writers are not coordinated with the DataFusion memory budget.

Writer lock is an empty create_new marker. Process death leaves a stale .write.lock that blocks future writes. Ordinary errors clean generations, but dropped write futures do not execute post-await cleanup; unpublished generations can remain.

LocalRead execution streams follow persisted original partition row counts and read files serially. Many physical files can therefore remain tied to a single old logical partition; provider integration must choose real runtime parallelism from work/resource budgets instead.
partition_key_bounds re-encodes already cached typed Arrow key bounds as IPC payloads; prefer partition_typed_key_bounds and remove internal transport callers.
Old immutable generations are deliberately retained and no GC exists. This is documented lifecycle debt, not a recommendation to delete generations while readers remain pinned.

row_and_byte_limits_flush_before_requesting_more_input now checks written.len() <= consumed batches. That does not prove bounded prefetch/retained memory; its name and older sequential guarantee are stronger than its assertion.

iceberg_metrics_pruning_drops_nan_rows_that_vortex_matches intentionally proves an existing upstream mismatch: Iceberg metrics can prune positive NaN for x > +infinity although native Arrow/Vortex total-order comparisons return true. Pushdown must account for this before enabling generic Iceberg predicates.

Documentation still claims per-file/global SHA256 checks and waiting for each file to close before polling input. Current code intentionally omits content hashes and supports 32 concurrent file writes. These claims are stale.
_aggregate_scan formerly sliced and re-aggregated each prefix. Replaced by exclusive native accumulator scans, with zipped scalar output callbacks to avoid captured-list replication.
approx_cdf is explicitly unsupported in agg_numeric.py. Its scan wrapper delegates without _mark; that is dormant inconsistency while the underlying API raises, not a current silently wrong scan.

Per-instance AtomicU64 function identities for state, merge and finish UDFs impede equivalent expression identity. The sum finisher also depends on an internal state layout, currently guarded by function name and state types.
Per-instance AtomicU64 names for immutable scope adapters weaken optimizer identity.
Grouped snapshots emit then restore DataFusion groups state because DF55's group adapter evaluation is destructive. Cost scales with emitted group-state size, including repeated snapshots.

zip formerly built range(size).map(i => arrays[i]); enumerate likewise indexed a captured full array. Native pairwise arrays_zip plus current-element projections remove full-list capture and repeated random-context binding.

corr formerly embedded whole-array means in each per-element covariance callback. Confirmed quadratic evaluation/memory:2000elements0.735s443MBmaxRSS;4000elements2.84s1.91GBmaxRSS. Replaced composition with shared native corr accumulator, preserving public empty/all-missing distinctions.
index_callback formerly built range(length).map(i => (i, collection[i])) and captured the full collection. Replaced by native zip with positional identities.

Mapped aggregate input expressions formerly used aggregate result type as their declared dtype. Native infer_type now traverses original input IR with source/global/lexical native Type context and supplies accurate metadata; no dummy literals or invented values.

problem: Whole localized matrix collected into Python before export.
resolution: Native Arrow batch stream sink, buffered file writer, atomic temporary-file publication.

problem: Selecting a narrow nonempty VCF projection still decodes all INFO and FORMAT fields and constructs all cells before projecting.
evidence: crates/vail-table/src/vcf_source.rs: count_only special case; otherwise parser.append then batch.finish then batch.project
crates/vail-vcf/src/lib.rs: Parser::append iterates all header.info and batch.entries
direction: Pass projection requirements into native parser/builders; skip unused field stripes and cells at parse time, retaining record/locus validity rules.

problem: FORMAT plan cache retains every distinct FORMAT string for the entire source lifetime.
evidence: crates/vail-vcf/src/lib.rs: Parser.plans HashMap; append inserts every newly observed format and never removes it
direction: Bound the cache by entries/bytes or use a small last-plan/LRU cache, with adversarial changing-FORMAT regression.

problem: Text/CSV/NDJSON sinks overwrite the actual destination while upstream execution can still fail, unlike staged native VCF output.
evidence: crates/vail-table/src/text_export.rs: sink_config uses original path and InsertOp::Overwrite; export drains DataSinkExec directly

problem: import_vcf unconditionally sorts rows. Correct for arbitrary unsorted VCF input, but redundant for verified sorted sources and can dominate first-action latency.
evidence: python/vail/vcf.py: final matrix._sort_rows call
direction: Retain ordering correctness; introduce validated source ordering proofs where available, never assume a VCF is sorted merely by filename.

title: Python RNG context rewrites still recursively rebuild occurrence trees
evidence: Native randomness detection is now graph-aware, but when randomness is present, contextual rewrite recurses through Python shallow views without native node/context memoization. Shared random-containing graphs can repeat rewrite work and reconstruct duplicated native children.
next_step: Validate public callback/reducer seeded randomness and depth64 random graph planning on matching candidate9 package.
resolution: Native randomness_binding rewrite memoizes original node plus lexical/reducer scope, retains Arc graph outputs, handles callback replacement/shadowing, reducer inputs/results and group result UID minima. Python preserves ownership refs and obtains row-index flag natively.

title: Projection schema inference canonicalizes away arbitrary Arrow field metadata
evidence: Table agent isolated pre-existing RuntimeLiteral projection schema loss: Type::from_arrow then to_arrow preserves recognized logical type but drops arbitrary Arrow List element Field metadata before collect. Raw native seed/physical return-field cases13/14 passed; failure is generic schema reconstruction, not configured UDAF forwarding.
next_step: Define native type representation retaining Arrow field metadata, or preserve exact source return Field when deriving projection schemas. Add real imported Arrow arbitrary-metadata roundtrip regression; coordinate table/type owners. No overlapping production fix in this batch.

evidence: Build7 actual test_row_aligned_views_and_transformations_do_not_index_rows passed in23.28s (prior build2 278.56s).

cProfile coherent isolated wheel:4 NativeTable.eval_global_arrow calls12.181s,9 count calls4.395s,18 aggregate_globals calls3.974s,3 grouped_aggregate calls0.883s. Wholeprofile23.181s; source file persisted in evidence.

title: Physical metadata facade validated rewritten lambda indices against the old source schema
evidence: Build7 densify and heterogeneous nested array/dict lambda cases failed with List/Dict versus Int comparator/arithmetic errors. DataFusion LambdaExpr projects column indices before supplying the new callback schema. Eager with_new_children metadata binding used the old schema, so rewritten indices addressed different types.
resolution: Child rewrites/snapshots invalidate derived fields. Per-node OnceLock seeds original shared Arc<Schema>/exact Field for constant-time common queries without wide-schema hashing or vector cloning; first actual projected schema binds rewritten nodes lazily. Other schemas use a success-only secondary map; no lock spans recursive metadata computation. Eq/hash exclude derived cache/labels. Compact root function/operator labels retained without recursive Display.
validation: Isolated package8 original nested-array/dict-global/densify regressions plus full optimizer suite:17passed .45s, guard .62s RSS175751168 bytes. New native metadata test queries actual descriptors and float/null execution across schemas; all new Hash/Eq inspection assertions removed per R7.

title: Alpha-equivalent pure lambda kernels retain frontend UUID binder spelling in identity
evidence: Native property descriptors include ArrayMap/Filter/Fold parameter strings and LambdaVariable names; frontend-generated binder UUIDs differ between independently constructed equivalent expressions. Stable actual-name identity is conservative but misses semantic reuse for alpha-equivalent binders.
next_step: Canonicalize lexical binders and bound-variable references by lexical depth/position in native identity, preserving distinct free references, capture/shadowing and actual type metadata. Add public equivalently constructed higher-order value/optimizer behavior tests without private implementation counters.

problem: Nested scan result substitution still recursively walks expression occurrences without a scoped DAG memo
evidence: Built::finish invokes substitute; helper uses Expr::try_map_children recursively with no node/context memo. Repeated shared finish subgraphs can be revisited per incoming path. No public end-to-end complexity reproduction yet.
direction: Reuse a common native lexical substitution utility with memo by node and scope, preserving shadowing and aggregate occurrence semantics. Validate with a bounded public shared-result planning probe; do not infer runtime CSE.
